```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df <- read_csv("data/dataset - 2020-09-24.csv")

names(df)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Player Ages",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Number of players"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Position, y = `Goals per match`)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Goals per Match by Position",
    x = "Position",
    y = "Goals per match"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
